headword: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}

definitions.gloss: call history; incoming call log; received call record
definitions.explanation: A record of incoming phone calls on a mobile phone or other device. A common feature on smartphones.

examples.japanese: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}を{確認|かくにん}した。
{知|し}らない{番号|ばんごう}が{着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}に{残|のこ}っていた。
examples.english: An unknown number was left in my call history.

examples.japanese: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}から{相手|あいて}に{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{電話|でんわ}をかけた。
examples.english: I called the person back from my call history.

notes:
USAGE:
A modern compound noun used in everyday phone-related contexts. {着信|ちゃくしん} (incoming call) + {履歴|りれき} (history/log).

RELATED TERMS:
- {発信|はっしん}{履歴|りれき}: outgoing call log
- {不在|ふざい}{着信|ちゃくしん}: missed call
- {通話|つうわ}{履歴|りれき}: call log (both incoming and outgoing)
